plainSummary: Custom engineering methods now preserve chosen skills and ordered attempts while accepting only current, scoped evidence under the tested attacks.
summary: Approved 25eac677-2871-816d-956d-770bdcb61798 on the frozen tree after failure-first repairs. Ten independent workflow breakers pass for poisoned contracts and forbidden order, workflow-storage and skill symlink confinement, bounded and immutable skill content, fresh amendment/attempt identity, cross-workstream and historical review rejection, unresolved blocking findings, criterion-to-behavioral-row mapping, attestation separation, explicit custom obligations, and within-stage order. Builder workflow unit tests pass 2/2; actual CLI/MCP tests pass the custom method lifecycle through real records on both executables and the existing lifecycle/negative/package matrix 6/6. UI presentation tests pass 3/3 inside the 9/9 UI set. Manual browser evidence shows an MCP-selected method, a live CLI update, failed current evidence, and disconnected stale observation. The recorded full regression completed 176 ledger + 6 MCP + 9 UI tests with zero failures.
